Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal MCV and MCH), which may be age-related or due to chronic disease. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width are elevated, suggesting increased platelet turnover or activation. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation is recommended.
Provider Organization: Complejo Hospitalario Ciudad de Jaén
